title: What Sugar Really Does to Your Teeth – Meet the Clean-Up Crew
description:
Sugar feeds the bacteria in plaque, and they make acid that attacks your enamel. Brushing twice a day with fluoride toothpaste sends in the clean-up crew.

Educational only. Not medical advice. Speak to a dentist about your own teeth.
character: a cute pure white molar tooth cartoon character with big round eyes, tiny arms and legs

scenes.label: SUGAR ARRIVES
scenes.image: worried face, looking up at colourful candies and sugar cubes falling from the sky toward it, standing on pink gums
scenes.motion: candy and sugar cubes fall and bounce around the tooth, the tooth leans back with a worried expression
scenes.narration: Every time you eat sugar, something happens inside your mouth.

scenes.label: BACTERIA MAKE ACID
scenes.image: small fuzzy bright green germ monsters biting the tooth, yellow bubbles on the tooth surface, the tooth grimacing
scenes.motion: the green germ monsters nibble the tooth and puff out small yellow bubbles, the tooth winces
scenes.narration: Bacteria feed on it and make acid that attacks your enamel.

scenes.label: BRUSH TWICE A DAY
scenes.image: a giant blue toothbrush with thick white foam scrubbing the tooth, foam bubbles everywhere, green germs washed away
scenes.motion: the giant toothbrush scrubs side to side, white foam bubbles rise and float, green germs slide away
scenes.narration: Brushing twice a day with fluoride toothpaste sends in the clean-up crew.

scenes.label: LESS SUGAR, LESS OFTEN
scenes.image: the tooth character sparkling clean and shiny white, smiling proudly with arms raised, small sparkles around it, healthy pink gums
scenes.motion: the tooth character bounces happily and waves, sparkles twinkle around it
scenes.narration: Cut down how often you have sugar, and your teeth stay strong.
